name: Difenoxin
aliases: Difenoxina, Difenoxinum, diphenoxilic acid, Diphenoxilic acid, Diphenoxin, diphenoxylic acid, Diphenoxylic acid, MCN-JR-15,403-11
summary: Difenoxin (Motofen, R-15403) is an opioid drug used, often in combination with atropine, to treat diarrhea. It is the principal metabolite of diphenoxylate.
